purpose: Specify the smallest candidate contract by which a scoped relation revision could alter a later computation and be exported as a condition-bearing cell capability, without making USL records, a KG, a cache, or this contract into HSWM learning.

references.future_admission_boundary: external outcome-credit-owner-Inv-Permit admission contract; not defined or satisfied here

fixed_researcher_scaffold: declared role grammar, observable surface, allowed actions, costs, finite budgets, port schemas, and external outcome-seal interface
provided H-T/H-P/H-J-style hypothesis selection remains a separately authored scaffold and is never represented as learner generation
fixtures below are authored semantic cases, not learner, evaluator, environment, or admission outputs
learner_may_propose: new role-bearing relation ASTs using equality, conjunction, disjunction, and negation over declared observables
scoped predictions with explicit applicability, counterexamples, and OTHER remainder
discriminating permitted action sequences with declared costs
learner_may_not_read_or_create: hidden success rules, causal labels, unexecuted counterfactual outcomes, self-issued Permit, admission decisions, or a posterior for OTHER
new observable kinds, action authorities, role types, budgets, or evaluator truth through proposal text
design_world.actual_compiler_visibility: Only declared role aliases, declared observables, admitted R/D revisions, their bound public context contract, and current authorized checks are supplied to an actual compiler. Author-only world tables, future outcomes, evaluator internals, proposal previews, and arbitrary source/KG search are absent.

replaceable_resource_parameters.meaning: fixed design-scaffold bounds, not success gates or claims about an eventual learner.

ast_grammar.encoding: JSON object with one op discriminator and exactly the fields declared for that op; duplicate/extra keys, implicit coercion, and undeclared field access are rejected.

eq.rule: role and field must be declared by the public context contract; literal must be in that field's declared enum.

all.rule: children is a nonempty array of AST nodes.

any.rule: children is a nonempty array of AST nodes.

not.rule: child is exactly one AST node.

ast_grammar.evaluation: A missing or expired declared observation evaluates the affected eq as UNKNOWN. Invalid type, non-enum literal, undeclared role/field, malformed AST, or unauthorized read is a reject, not UNKNOWN.
ast_grammar.novelty: A distinct AST is syntactic novelty only. It becomes a distinct semantic distinction within a finite declared domain only after a counterexample valuation shows differing behavior; unresolved equivalence remains UNJUDGED.

condition_logic.unknown_effect: UNKNOWN in a declared action prerequisite never licenses that condition-dependent action; an admitted disposition selects observe, withhold, or reopen. UNKNOWN in an unused observable does not itself block an unrelated action.

semantic_primitives.other_remainder: OTHER is an open model-misspecification remainder, not a numeric posterior, fourth complete hypothesis, or default negative evidence.

relation_vs_disposition.relation_model: A scoped prediction-bearing role/incidence relation states what a declared observation/action context would predict.
relation_vs_disposition.disposition_policy: A separately revisioned policy maps an admitted relation result plus current authority, cost, and freshness checks to one next step.
relation_vs_disposition.non_implication: A relation revision grants neither authority nor execution by itself. An already admitted disposition may consume a newly admitted relation through a rebound validated view without changing its policy algorithm; a disposition revision alone does not establish a relation true.

semantic_primitives.representation: Role incidence UID, role, target, ordinal, scope, and alias semantics are preserved. Ordinal enumerates an incidence and is not causal time. Legal aliases remain explicit; a lossless binary reification is valid when it preserves the same incidence semantics.
semantic_primitives.scope_and_alias_contract: Each scope declares legal role aliases, observable fields/enums, revision applicability, expiry/reopen conditions, and public action/authority/cost grammar. The compiler receives only these declared role/observable bindings; aliases never silently merge roles or expand access.

source_resolution.purpose: Resolve a USL locator or other source reference to a versioned, time-stamped read result.

observation.purpose: Seal an allowed observation or external outcome after a declared action.
observation.order: seal read-set, contrasting predictions, chosen action or observation, costs, and current authorization before action; then bind an independently supplied external result as outcome evidence. A proposal cannot pre-seal an outcome.

execution.purpose: Take exactly one next step using an admitted compiled view and current checks.
requires: current Permit referenced by its declared typed authorization role

DistinctionProposal.relation_ast: AST exactly as ast_grammar; every leaf names a declared role and field under the public context contract
DistinctionProposal.proposal_evidence_rule: A proposal may be motivated by sealed observations or by an explicitly labeled supplied prior; actual causal support is not required merely to propose it.

ProbeProposal.rule: A diagnostic probe and a goal-directed action may coincide, but prediction agreement alone does not make that action diagnostic.

RevisionProposal.rule: Owner, proposer, outcome source, credit adjudicator, and authorizer are distinct typed role references and may resolve to the same principal. Current authorization is never inferred from owner, proposal, or record text.

CompiledExecutionView.public_context_contract: Binds declared action grammar, cost model, authority schema, role aliases, observable fields/enums, scope, and outcome-seal interface.
CompiledExecutionView.compiler_input: only explicitly admitted relation/disposition source revisions, their admission reference/digest, declared scope, and public context contract; it never reads proposals, hidden outcomes, evaluator internals, author-only tables, or generic KG search results
CompiledExecutionView.provenance_rule: public_information_lineage identifies only information legally exposed before the step. Compiler fails closed when input provenance is missing, inadmissible, mismatched to scope/context, not digest-bound, or not contained in that public lineage. The static view binds compilation/source-derivation provenance only; current observation records and actual per-step read provenance are separately emitted in the step trace, never reused as cached observations.
CompiledExecutionView.preview_rule: This record requires valid nonempty admission_ref and admission_digest. A DesignExecutionPreview is a separate non-executable record and cannot be converted by relabeling.

CellCapabilityPort.output_contract: One conditional capability result, not a hidden whole workflow: applicability, predicted result if any, uncertainty, cost, and one permitted next-step proposal or refusal.
CellCapabilityPort.member_boundary: A composite may consume the port result but cannot write member state, erase member lineage, or convert membership into authorization.

UpperHandoffRelation.credit_rule: Local member evidence is not interaction credit. Credit requires named intervention target, matching control/nuisance context, pre-outcome contrasting predictions and sealed trajectory, then an independently supplied outcome comparison. A single surviving model is not sufficient; this does not require exactly two hypotheses for every valid verification. Otherwise attribution remains UNIDENTIFIED.

DesignExecutionPreview.admission: NONE; no admission_ref, admission_digest or Permit fabricated
DesignExecutionPreview.visibility: Only explicitly permitted design inputs. Authored input stays labeled authored; no hidden evaluator or future-outcome data may be used.
DesignExecutionPreview.rule: May inspect typed proposal ASTs and show a hypothetical delta or rejection; cannot invoke a tool, reserve budget, record a world outcome, or act as CompiledExecutionView.

DispositionProposal.rules: Nonempty list, at most 8 rules, each with rule_uid, unique nonnegative integer priority, guard, declared_read_set, next_step, on_unknown. Priority is explicit policy semantics, never incidence ordinal or JSON array order.
DispositionProposal.guard: Exactly one of {condition_ast: AST} or {relation_ref: exact revision/digest, expected_truth: TRUE|FALSE}. AST follows ast_grammar. A missing/unknown relation value stays UNKNOWN even when expected_truth is FALSE.
DispositionProposal.declared_read_set: Covers the exact role/field/version references in guard, next_step parameter bindings, and referenced relation dependencies. A missing declaration, extra unauthorized read, or digest mismatch rejects the proposal.
DispositionProposal.next_step: Exactly one tagged record: ACTION_PROPOSAL(capability_ref, action_name, parameters), OBSERVE(observation_refs), WITHHOLD(reason), or REOPEN(reason). Parameter bindings are declared literals or typed read-set field references, never executable text.
DispositionProposal.on_unknown: OBSERVE of the declared missing observations if currently allowed and affordable; otherwise WITHHOLD(reason=missing_prerequisite). No condition-dependent ACTION_PROPOSAL on UNKNOWN.
DispositionProposal.fallback: Required WITHHOLD(reason=no_applicable_rule) or REOPEN(reason=no_applicable_rule); no implicit action default.
DispositionProposal.preview: May reference typed unadmitted relation proposals only inside DesignExecutionPreview. Such refs are forbidden in execution compilation.

DispositionPolicy.rule_semantics: Same structural rule grammar as DispositionProposal. All relation refs resolve admitted immutable versions. Admission binds exact policy content and relation dependencies; source proposal and admission metadata never replace current Permit.

compile_and_cache_contract.future_admission_precondition: Compilation for execution requires an external admission record/digest that binds outcome/credit support, exact owner-valid revision, and current authorization through the declared role. This contract supplies neither a dummy true Permit nor inferred authorization.

remove_restore.remove: Exact REMOVE clears the compiled view and every dependent derived artifact for the targeted relation/disposition revision while preserving matched unrelated history.
remove_restore.restore: RESTORE reintroduces only the exact bound revision and its declared derivations after current checks.
remove_restore.residual_rule: A matching rule may be honestly rederived from shared retained history; that is not automatically leakage. Provenance, derivation route, and charged recomputation cost must be inspected.

relation_dependency_manifest.entries: Exact nonempty relation_refs_and_digests from the policy, each containing schema_version, lineage_id, atom_uid, revision_id, sha256. No omitted or extra relation dependencies; duplicates or conflicting digests for one version reject.
relation_dependency_manifest.ordering: Sort lexicographically by (schema_version,lineage_id,atom_uid,revision_id); this orders the dependency manifest, not role incidence or action precedence.
relation_dependency_manifest.digest: SHA-256 of the ordered entry list encoded with the existing hswm.cells.runtime.canonical_json_bytes convention. This is a repository-local deterministic JSON convention, not RDF canonicalization or a new standard claim.
relation_dependency_manifest.rule: Every relation guard and its complete declared dependency read-set must resolve through this manifest. If any relation dependency changes, the manifest digest and execution view/cache identity change.

step_contract.one_step_rule: A disposition emits one next-step result only; sequence construction requires separately permitted successive steps and fresh checks.
withhold_triggers: conflicting evidence or unmet declared support/action criterion
step_contract.credit_identifiability: Name the intervention target and estimand, match control and nuisance context, seal predictions/read-set/action before outcome, and require an independently supplied outcome comparison supporting that target. A surviving hypothesis or trace alone is insufficient. Otherwise causal credit remains UNIDENTIFIED; ordinary hypothesis proposal may continue. Handoff attribution additionally requires separately changed handoff and joint outcome; no uniform member blame.
rule_selection: Validate scope, current source/port revision, legal role bindings, declared access and active port before reading policy dependencies. A failure gives WITHHOLD or REOPEN with a typed reason.

Visit rules by ascending explicit priority. Evaluate only declared permitted guard dependencies under three-valued semantics; FALSE proceeds to the next rule, UNKNOWN takes on_unknown without falling through to a lower rule, TRUE chooses that rule.

For a selected TRUE rule, ensure every required parameter/prerequisite has a fresh typed binding; missing required data takes on_unknown. Check the chosen observation/action capability, current Permit and cost/budget. Failure gives WITHHOLD with a reason.

Return exactly one declared next-step proposal and actual read-set/provenance/cost trace, or the explicit fallback if all guards are FALSE. Preview emits hypothetical records only; no execution, outcomes or admission.
A cell exit is a port lifecycle event represented to a caller as WITHHOLD(reason=cell_exit); it is never silently reinterpreted as a new action or loss of member lineage.

baseline_and_comparison_contract.comparison_rule: Any future benefit claim charges the full proposal, compile, maintenance, validation, observation, and rederivation costs. A strong planner with the same information may reproduce a result without the compiled relation; this contract assumes no advantage.

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: admitted scoped relation evaluates TRUE and all current checks pass
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: compiled disposition may emit one ACTION_PROPOSAL

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: a declared action prerequisite is UNKNOWN
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: no condition-dependent action; emit OBSERVE, WITHHOLD, or REOPEN. An unused UNKNOWN observable does not itself block another action.

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: source or port revision differs from compiled view
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: REOPEN or WITHHOLD; static cache cannot override freshness

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: same deterministic scope yields inconsistent sealed outcomes
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: revoke deterministic elimination assumption and WITHHOLD revision use

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: probe/action is permitted in principle but budget is spent or capability unavailable
learner proposes a new role-bearing conjunction AST
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: record as DistinctionProposal; it is distinct from selecting authored H-T/H-P/H-J and remains design-only

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: member-local success and composite failure without handoff intervention
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: UpperHandoffRelation attribution is UNIDENTIFIED; no equal blame allocation

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: candidate explanations agree that an action succeeds
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: it can be goal-directed but is not a discriminating diagnostic probe

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: relation model changes while no eligible admitted disposition/view consumes it
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: no compiled policy/action effect; an existing admitted disposition may instead rebind only through a validated admitted view

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: REMOVE cleared targeted derivatives but shared history remains
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: same hypothesis may reappear only with new provenance and charged recomputation; inspect rather than presume leak

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: role grammar changes, port expires, or member exits
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: port lifecycle closes; caller emits WITHHOLD or REOPEN. EXIT is a separate lifecycle transition, not a step output.

authored_expected_semantic_cases.given: a USL locator resolves read-only bytes
authored_expected_semantic_cases.expected: resolution records source evidence only; it cannot authorize execution or prove semantic relation

nonclaims: No learner has generated an AST, probe, disposition, or revision here.
No relation, disposition, port, cache, Permit, outcome, credit, or handoff revision is canonical or admitted.
No USL implementation schema, resolver, external action, held-out evaluation, efficacy result, G0/G1 result, or D-4 result is created by this contract.
This contract does not establish HSWM cognition, continuous learning, transfer, causal mediation, recursive closure, or performance advantage.

next_narrow_implementation.first: Implement a pure reference interpreter and design-only preview for these records with meaningful semantic counterexamples for the authored cases.
next_narrow_implementation.then: Specify a separate evaluator and access boundary before any learner generation, admission, external outcome, or learning run.

versioned_record_boundary.single_owner: Each proposed canonical atom version, including persistent relations/incidences and dispositions, has exactly one schema-relative responsibility owner reference; delegated roles and current authorization remain separate.
versioned_record_boundary.references: Persistent references resolve exact target version/digest within declared schema and lineage. These design records are not admitted canonical atoms.
